questions.question: What does the psalm poetically say the sea and Jordan did?
options: The sea fled and the Jordan turned back
The rock split open and water gushed out
The sun stood still and the moon halted
The heavens opened and manna rained down
questions.answer: The sea fled and the Jordan turned back
